sources.snippet: Constrained by the model's size, a robust backbone Enhanced Res2Net (ERes2Net) combining global and local feature fusion demonstrates sub-optimal performance in short-duration speaker verification. To further improve the short-duration feature extraction capability of ERes2Net, we expand the channel dimension within each stage.
